source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of assignment operators (PDF 39).

blocks.text: Assignment operators variables ko value dete hain. Sab se aam = hai: daen (right) taraf ki value baen (left) taraf ke variable mein rakh deta hai. Compound assignment operators, jaise +=, -=, *= aur /=, arithmetic (hisaab) aur assignment ko ek saath kar dete hain: a += b ka matlab hai a = a + b.

# Define initial values
a = 10
b = 5

# Assignment
assignment = a; print("a =", assignment) # Output: a = 10
# Addition assignment
a += b; print("a after addition =", a)# Output: a = 15
# Subtraction assignment
a -= b; print("a after subtraction =", a)# Output: a = 10
# Multiplication assignment
a *= b; print("a after multiplication =", a)# Output: a = 50
# Division assignment
a /= b; print("a after division =", a)# Output: a = 10.0
# Floor division assignment
a //= b; print("a after floor division =", a)# Output: a = 2.0
# Modulus assignment
a %= b; print("a after modulus =", a)# Output: a = 2.0
# Exponentiation assignment
a **= b; print("a after exponentiation =",a)#Output: a= 32.0

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"a = 10" aur "b = 5": shuru ki values. Har line a ki nayi value banati hai, aur agli line usi nayi value par kaam karti hai.
"assignment = a": = sirf value copy karta hai; assignment mein 10 aata hai. Semicolon (;) se ek line mein do statements likhe gaye hain.
"a += b": a = a + b, yani 10 + 5 = 15.
"a -= b": 15 - 5 = 10.
"a *= b": 10 * 5 = 50.
"a /= b": 50 / 5 = 10.0. / hamesha float (decimal wala number) deta hai, is liye ab se a float hai.
"a //= b": 10.0 // 5 = 2.0 (floor division, sirf poora hissa).
"a %= b": 2.0 % 5 = 2.0 (5 se taqseem par baqi 2.0 bachta hai).
"a **= b": 2.0 ** 5 = 32.0 (power).
Output: aath lines: "a = 10", "a after addition = 15", "a after subtraction = 10", "a after multiplication = 50", "a after division = 10.0", "a after floor division = 2.0", "a after modulus = 2.0", "a after exponentiation = 32.0". Kitab ke comments mein label chhota likha hai (jaise "a = 15"); asal line mein poora label "a after addition =" chhapta hai.
Khud try karein: b = 2 kar ke Run karein: values 12, 10, 20, 10.0, 5.0, 1.0, 1.0 aayengi (pehli line "a = 10" wahi rahegi).
Har line a ki nayi value deti hai. Values ek ke baad ek badalti hain: 10, 15, 10, 50, 10.0, 2.0, 2.0, 32.0. /= ke baad a float (10.0) ban jata hai, is liye baad ki values bhi float hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Comments sirf a ki value dikhate hain. Screen par poori line aati hai, maslan "a after addition = 15" aur "a after floor division = 2.0".

blocks.prompt: Agar a = 4 ho to a *= 3 aur phir a -= 2 ke baad a kya hai?
blocks.explanation: a *= 3 se a = 12, phir a -= 2 se a = 10.

items: = value deta hai; += -= *= /= //= %= **= hisaab kar ke wapas usi variable mein rakhte hain.
